dealer_state_trigger: Maal deliver hue 48 ghante ho gaye hain par dealer se koi baat nahi hui
wrong_approach: Call karke seedha agla order mangna: 'Sir agla order kab milega?'
joe_girard_script: Namaste [Dealer Name] ji! Bas ye check karne ke liye phone kiya ki parso ka 30 bags ka dispatch theek se unload ho gaya na? Bori me koi damage toh nahi? Shahrukh bhai ne fresh silica quartz batch nikalwaya tha.
rm_action_sop: Day 2 check-in is strictly non-commercial. Verify bags arrived safely. Greet counter helper by name. Record batch feedback.

dealer_state_trigger: Pichle order ko 10 din ho gaye hain, stock lagbhag khatam hone ko hai par reorder nahi aaya
wrong_approach: Sir please order do na, target poora karna hai
joe_girard_script: Namaste [Dealer Name] ji! Pichle 10 din me counter se lagbhag 30 bag texture nikal chuka hai jisse counter par seedha ₹12,000 ka net cash profit generate hua. Counter dry na ho aur painters dusri dukan par na mud jayein, isiliye kya Monday subah ke liye fresh 30 bags ka batch schedule kar dein?
financial_or_relationship_metric: ₹12,000 net profit realized on 30 bags (vs ₹1,350 on MNC brand)
rm_action_sop: Never beg for orders. Calculate and voice the exact rupee profit the dealer pocketed. Frame reorder as protecting customer flow.

dealer_state_trigger: Invoice Day 4 par chal raha hai, payment pending hai
wrong_approach: Aap payment kab doge? Hamara paisa atka hua hai
joe_girard_script: Namaste [Dealer Name] ji! Bas ek gentle reminder tha — invoice INV-104 ka 2% Cash Discount slot kal sham close ho raha hai. Agar aap kal 5:00 PM tak RTGS/UPI clear kar dete hain toh ₹690 seedha aapka extra bachta hai.
financial_or_relationship_metric: 2% Cash Discount (₹690 cash saved on ₹34,500 billing)
rm_action_sop: Send friendly reminder framed as a direct monetary saving for the dealer. Do not show desperation or doubt.

dealer_state_trigger: Invoice 7th day par aa gaya hai, payment abhi tak nahi aayi
wrong_approach: Agar payment nahi doge toh hum delivery band kar denge aur legal notice bhejenge
joe_girard_script: Namaste [Dealer Name] ji! Main jaanta hoon aap counter par busy rehte hain. Company ki strict audit policy ke mutabiq 7-day cycle par invoice clear hona zaroori hota hai taaki factory se agla dispatch automatically approve ho sake. Hum dono ka commercial relation ekdum smooth rahe, isiliye kya hum ise aaj sham tak UPI ya cheque se close kar lein?
financial_or_relationship_metric: Strict 7-day credit cycle preservation without personal friction
rm_action_sop: Blame the institutional ERP system and audit policy, not the dealer. Keep voice respectful, smiling, and firm.

dealer_state_trigger: Dealer ka counter response thanda pad raha hai, call ignore kar raha hai
wrong_approach: Dealer ko ignore karke dusri dukan par move kar jana
joe_girard_script: [Dealer Name] ji, mujhe laga pichle hafte hamara connect thoda kam raha. Kya painters ko aggregate ya setting me koi shikayat aayi, ya margin calculation me koi confusion hai? Jo bhi baat ho aap openly batao — main Shahrukh bhai (Senior Chemist) ko sath lekar counter par aa jata hoon. Aap hamare core partner ho, har issue solve karna meri personal zimmedari hai.
rm_action_sop: Immediately visit the counter in person with tea/snacks. Listen without defending. Bring senior chemist if quality is questioned.

dealer_state_trigger: Dealer ke pass 4 naye thekedar texture maangne aaye hain
wrong_approach: Sir dekha maine kaha tha na, ab aur 100 bag lo
joe_girard_script: Namaste [Dealer Name] ji! Badhai ho — kal jo 4 naye thekedar aapki dukan par Swatch maangne aaye the, ye aapki dukan ki saakh aur Swatch ke finish ka result hai. Law of 250 ke mutabiq jab ek thekedar khush hota hai toh 10 aur aate hain. Aise hi counter grow karega!
financial_or_relationship_metric: 250 indirect buyers activated per satisfied dealer counter
rm_action_sop: Congratulate the dealer on building trade authority. Attribute success to their local goodwill and Swatch product quality.
